senses.gloss: m. (פְּרַק, with anorg. נ) [torn off,] 2) rag used to cover wine casks &c.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 30a:9">Ab. Zar. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>צרונהי בפ׳</he> they tied a shred around it.

<cite ref="Shabbat 48a:2">Sabb. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>מאי שנא מפ׳</he> wherein is this different from covering the cask with a rag? <cite ref="Shabbat 139b:16">Ib. 139ᵇ</cite> <he>האי פ׳ אפלגא וכ׳</he> to spread a shred over a part of a cask is permitted. [Ar. reads <cite ref="Q01907"><he>פְּרַנְקָא</he></cite>.]
